name: todo-api
description: Owns lists, tasks, list membership, and in-app notifications. Exposes REST endpoints to create and manage todo lists, add/edit/complete/delete tasks with due date, priority, and categories, invite and manage collaborators on a shared list, and read/mark in-app notifications for invitations and task assignments. Does not send email or push notifications, and does not issue or validate auth tokens itself (the gateway validates them against Thunder).
